parameters.name: administrator
parameters.rationale: Role checked via serverInterface.isUserInRole('administrator') in processViewEntry, processVoteEntry, processSpamEntry, processVoteComment, processSpamComment. Determines elevated privileges for admin operations.

parameters.name: trusted
parameters.rationale: Role obtained through serverInterface.isUserInRole('trusted') and propagated to saveEntry/saveBlogEntry, where it controls trusted-user HTML handling.
